result.markdown:
# Sahel Sites Outage Due to Planned Fibre Splicing

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of maintenance window matching alarm timing, link loss, and subsequent site down alarms on affected nodes.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-06 07:15 to 2026-09-06 13:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-06 07:16
- **Affected:** S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, S-SAH-009

## Summary

Planned fibre splice work on link LNK-SAH-01-B caused a link loss of signal, taking downstream sites offline.

Three Sahel sites experienced total traffic loss, active user drops, and availability loss for over six hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-06 07:15: Traffic, users, and availability drop started on three Sahel sites. [ALR-0004]
- 2026-09-06 07:16: Planned fibre splice work maintenance window MW-0004 started on LNK-SAH-01-B. [MW-0004]
- 2026-09-06 07:22: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000100]
- 2026-09-06 07:23: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009. [ALM-000101, ALM-000102, ALM-000103]
- 2026-09-06 13:20: LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN alarms on LNK-SAH-01-B, S-SAH-009, and S-SAH-008 cleared. [ALM-000100, ALM-000101, ALM-000103]
- 2026-09-06 13:23: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-SAH-007 cleared. [ALM-000102]
- 2026-09-06 13:30: Alert ALR-0004 ended as metrics recovered. [ALR-0004]

## Evidence

- Maintenance window MW-0004 on LNK-SAH-01-B started at 2026-09-06 07:16 with expected downstream impact. [MW-0004]
- Critical link loss alarm ALM-000100 occurred on LNK-SAH-01-B at 2026-09-06 07:22. [ALM-000100]
- Critical site down alarms occurred on S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009 starting at 2026-09-06 07:23. [ALM-000101, ALM-000102, ALM-000103]
- No unexpected configuration changes occurred on affected nodes during the window. [T5]
- No external events were recorded in the region during the incident timeframe. [T8]

## Inferences

- The transport link failure and maintenance caused the simultaneous outage of all three dependent Sahel sites. [MW-0004, ALM-000100, ALM-000101]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Planned fibre splice work on LNK-SAH-01-B directly caused the LINK_LOS and subsequent downstream site outages. [MW-0004, ALM-000100]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-B: rejected. The transport failure was explicitly planned and tracked under maintenance window MW-0004, not an unannounced failure. [MW-0004]

## Ruled out

- T5: Checked for changes on affected nodes and parents; none were found, ruling out bad changes as a cause.
- T8: Checked for external events in the region; none were recorded, ruling out environmental or external triggers.

## Recommended actions

- Verify post-maintenance fiber attenuation levels on LNK-SAH-01-B.
- Confirm stable traffic handling across S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-009.
- Ensure customer communications regarding planned maintenance are tightly aligned with execution windows.

- `ALM-000101`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-009, raised 2026-09-06 07:23, cleared 2026-09-06 13:20

report.title: Sahel Sites Outage Due to Planned Fibre Splicing

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SAH-01-B that ended 204 min before service returned; it explains only the first part of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; The sites of LNK-SAH-01-B went down inside the maintenance window on LNK-SAH-01-B and stayed down 204 min after it closed: the part inside the window is planned work, the remainder is an unplanned outage and is labelled an incident. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the start of the outage (LNK-SAH-01-B), but the outage runs hours past its end. Settled by: (1) the outage continues 204 min after the window ends, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN stay active after the window closed instead of clearing with the end of the works.
